system.description:
ARBALIST SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000322]{Black Powder} 【Max SL 4】

Once per turn when a creature is hit by one of your ranged weapon attacks, automatically deal (SL) damage of the attack's type to up to two other creatures within melee range; then roll a d8, and on a 2 or lower you or a willing ally also takes the full damage dealt. During your turn you may spend 10 MP to make your next Black Powder this turn deal (SL x 2) instead.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000323]{Scattershot}

When you make a ranged attack with multi (2) or higher against more than one enemy, spend 5 MP to have each hit target a random enemy (which may repeat the same enemy), increasing the attack's multi by 1.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000324]{Titankiller Armament} 【Max SL 5】

When you attack with a ranged weapon, you may replace up to one die in its Accuracy Check with (MIG); if you do, the attack gains (SL) bonus damage but you suffer weak or slow until the end of your next turn, ignoring immunities.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000325]{Wallbuster}

When you succeed on a Check to fill or erase Clock sections and your approach relied on overt demolition, reckless collateral, or unnecessary force, fill or erase 2 additional sections of that Clock.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000326]{Slow Match} 【Max SL 4】

After you hit an enemy with a ranged attack, spend 10 MP to deal no damage and delay it, choosing: the next time you or an ally hits that enemy, add (SL + delayed damage) bonus damage; or deal (SL + delayed damage) fire damage to it at the start of a chosen creature's turn; or deal that fire damage to it at the end of the round.
